title: Kamishiro Rui — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Rui's Birthday
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hm. No issues with the movement, and the responsiveness is acceptable.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That about wraps up maintenance on my drones.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, another one from Emu?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Because we couldn't celebrate on my actual birthday, she's been sending me a message every hour like clockwork.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It was a little surprising at first, but this kind of celebration is nice too.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa and Nene also stopped by to give me their well-wishes. How kind of them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now then, with my maintenance done, I should head home—
Oh, good! You're here today!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki. I didn't realize you were at school today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it was getting to the point I had to show up eventually...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, I'm glad I came in today, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I just remembered earlier—it's your birthday, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So I was like, “I wonder if he's still here...” and decided to at least check.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm honored you remembered.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, I got you a present and everything!
Let's see, where is it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Here! Happy birthday, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, is this soda candy?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I got it at the school store! I splurged a bit and got every bag they had♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You certainly don't do things by half-measures. Still...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems like quite a few people have a very strong impression that I like soda candy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, you do, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe, I certainly do.
I graciously accept.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Good!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, are you by yourself today? I thought you'd be hanging out with Tsukasa and the others.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They had wanted to as well, but unfortunately, circumstances didn't allow it. However, they did throw me a celebration over the weekend.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aw, I see. I hope it was a fun party.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Speak of the devil. It's Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What's going on? Is there something—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Good, he picked up!
Rui, are you still at school?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I am, but... Why, has something happened?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “No, we're looking for you.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Rui! Look there! Down by the school gate!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
The gate?
Is that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hahaha! The gang's all here!
Looks like they all made the time to come by somehow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wonder.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
They obviously did!
Go on, go and see them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They're all waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're right.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll see you later.
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What a surprise.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought you all had things to take care of today, so I wasn't prepared for this at all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. The family thing I had to go to ended up getting canceled.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So I thought, “I can probably still make it to see Rui!” And I came running at full speed!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And she sent us a message to that effect, too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And Tsukasa and I both went into overdrive getting everything wrapped up for our hall monitor and committee work.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If we're going to celebrate a friend, we should do it all together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I certainly couldn't have predicted this. It's a true birthday surprise.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, it was a happy accident rather than a plan. But as long as you're pleased, that's good enough for me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, now that the star of the day has arrived, let's get this celebration going.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Emu
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought the party the other day was enough, but there really is something special about having everyone together on my actual birthday.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It sounds like it's time for Birthday Party 2, then!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We don't have anything prepped, but we can buy what we need.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Since we have the chance, I'd like to do something different from the last party!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We had lots of sweet snacks last time, so how about savory stuff today?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we get something with a lot of meat? Hold the veggies, of course!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They showed up for me and thought of things for me to enjoy...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I truly can never thank them enough.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A second party, you say? This will be a birthday to remember.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Happy birthday! We heard all about your party from Emu!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She mentioned shows, games and magic... I was having fun just listening to her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Tsukasa and the others must have wanted very much for you to enjoy yourself, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For sure! Once again, happy birthday, Kamishiro. We're all hoping you have a great year!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Be sure to tell us when you hold your next show! We'll come and see it for sure!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: An, Akito & Toya
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It sounds like you got a whole bunch of soda candy! Mizuki told me all about it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So Kamishiro likes soda candy... Maybe we should get him some, too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: True. Seems like there are a bunch of kinds that you can't find in Japan.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll have to find you some really great soda candy! Please look forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Happy birthday! It sounds as though you had a very lively day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Otori said you had a lot of fun, after all. You had two whole parties, even.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If something is fun, you should do a lot of it! That fits Wonderlands×Showtime very well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe, that's true. A very happy birthday to you, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Rui♪
I'm glad you got to spend your birthday with Tsukasa and the others!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Seriously, that was amazing! Everyone had stuff to do, but they all came running for you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They must really have wanted to celebrate with you. It's nice to have friends like that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday from me too, Kamishiro. When Mizuki told me what happened, it really made me smile too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We're rooting for you all, Rui. Keep up the good work!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Once again, happy birthday to you!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! “Happy birthday” is a joy to say, no matter how many times one says it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And birthday parties are fun no matter how many you have, too! They make everyone so smiley♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We got carried away and ended up getting home pretty late... But Rui seemed happy, so I'm glad we all got together on the day of.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. And with our spirits revitalized by that fun time together, let us continue our shared march forward!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We couldn't do this without you, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To think I could be caught so off-guard by a surprise...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I truly am blessed with fine companions. And, of course, with everyone else who has supported me all this time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you all for your kind wishes. I'll use my shows to convey my gratitude.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I hope you'll continue to support Wonderlands×Showtime. And we'll keep on bringing you smiles and joy.
